title: The Worst Thing You Could Do When a Police Officer Shows Up
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On December 9, 2023, a deputy responded to a gas station where the caller claimed his friend was paranoid in Lake City, FL. The man eventually grew more irate and took off in an ambulance, leading deputies on a pursuit that ended at the Columbia County Sheriff's Office doorstep, where the ambulance got stuck just feet before the entrance doors.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
